coreIdea: Regex = concat + union(|) + star(*). Same power as FA. r+ ≠ r* (one-or-more vs zero-or-more). No native complement/intersection — go via automaton for those.
mustRememberFormulas: (a|b)* = Σ* (all strings) — NOT the same as a*b* (only a's-then-b's)

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: specific string membership, or count/shortest-non-member asked

commonTrapsQuickList: r+ requires at least ONE occurrence, r* allows zero — don't mix up
Regex has NO native negation/intersection — convert to automaton for those operations
∅* = ε (NOT ∅) — star of nothing is still the empty string
Syntactically different regexes can represent the SAME language — always verify, don't assume
highYieldPyqLessons: Translation (11/29) is the biggest sub-skill — practice decomposing complex English descriptions into regex sub-patterns.
Equivalence checking (8/29) rewards memorizing the identity list cold, then falling back to string-testing when identities don't immediately resolve it.
